# Acceptance checklist

<!-- Generated by persona/scripts/acceptance-table.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Each row is a claim the project makes, and the test that proves it. Produced by
running `persona/tests/acceptance.int.test.ts` against a real PostgreSQL database
and a real OpenID Connect authorization-code flow — not a simulation.

**29 of 29 passing.**

## the right data for the context

| Requirement | Result |
|---|---|
| gives a healthcare app the legal name | ✅ pass |
| gives a social app the public name for the same person | ✅ pass |
| resolves the name variant from the app’s purpose, not from what it asks for | ✅ pass |
| releases structured fields as objects, not as flattened strings | ✅ pass |

## field minimisation — an app gets only what it should

| Requirement | Result |
|---|---|
| never releases a field the app did not ask for | ✅ pass |
| refuses an authorization for a scope the app never declared | ✅ pass |
| never releases a field the person declined at the consent screen | ✅ pass |
| releases the value the person chose over the one Persona suggested | ✅ pass |
| stops honouring a live token once the app narrows its own scopes | ✅ pass |

## the person stays in control

| Requirement | Result |
|---|---|
| shows exactly which values each connected app holds | ✅ pass |
| writes every release of data to the person’s audit log | ✅ pass |
| cuts an app off the moment the person revokes it | ✅ pass |
| lets the person export everything they hold in one file | ✅ pass |

## the provider is trustworthy infrastructure

| Requirement | Result |
|---|---|
| keeps a connection working across a restart of the provider | ✅ pass |
| never hands a client secret back through the API | ✅ pass |
| rejects a token request with the wrong client secret | ✅ pass |
| rejects an authorization sent to an unregistered redirect URI | ✅ pass |
| hides one developer’s app from another | ✅ pass |
| refuses to start an authorization for a paused app | ✅ pass |
| leaves an app with no working tokens once it is deleted | ✅ pass |

## proving a real person is behind the account

| Requirement | Result |
|---|---|
| creates no account until the code emailed to the address comes back | ✅ pass |
| creates the account and starts the vault once the code is entered | ✅ pass |
| leaves nothing behind when the code is wrong | ✅ pass |
| never stores the code in a form anyone could read back | ✅ pass |
| gives up on a code after five wrong guesses | ✅ pass |
| refuses a code that has expired | ✅ pass |
| asks for a code at sign-in as well, not just at sign-up | ✅ pass |
| asks for a code on the consent screen too, so it is no way around | ✅ pass |

## deleting an account

| Requirement | Result |
|---|---|
| erases the person and every trace of them, and kills their live tokens | ✅ pass |
